G0500:
άντι-χριατος, -ον, ό 
 Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): 1Jn.2:18 Jn 2:22 Jn 4:3, 1Jn.1:7 pl. 1Jn.2:18 (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0501:
ἀντλέω, -ῶ
 (ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;] 
__1. prop., to bale out. 
 __2. Generally, to draw water: absol., Jhn.2:8 4:15; ὕδωρ, Jhn.2:9 4:7 (on its use of the water made wine, see DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, see word; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†
 (AS)
G0502:
ἄντλημα, -τος, τό
 (ἀντλέω), 
__(a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.); 
 __(b) a vessel to draw with, a bucket (Plut.; see Abbott, Essays, 88): Jhn.4:11.†
 (AS)
G0503:
ἀντοφθαλμέω, -ῶ
 (ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wis.12:14 * ;] 
to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaphorical, to face, withstand (Wis, l.with, Polyb.): with dative, ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, to beat up against the wind (see DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Act.27:15.†
 (AS)
G0504:
ἄνυδρος, -ον
 (ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ),  etc. ;] 
waterless: τόποι, Mat.12:43, Luk.11:24; πηγαί, 2Pe.2:17; νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0505:
ἀν-υπόκριτος, -ον
 (ά- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι) [in LXX: Wis.5:18 18:16 * ;] 
unfeigned: Rom.12:9, 2Co.6:6, 1Ti.1:5, 2Ti.1:5, Jas.3:17, 1Pe.1:22 (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0506:
ἀνυπότακτος, -ον
 (ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: 1Ki.2:12 10:27 (for LXX, λοιμός,  בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;] 
of things, not subject to rule: Heb.2:8; of persons, unruly: 1Ti.1:9, Tit.1:6, 10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0507:
ἄνω
  adv (ἀνά), 
__(a) up, upwards: Jhn.11:41, Heb.12:15; 
 __(b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, Gal.4:26, Php.3:14; τά, Jhn.8:23, Col.3:1-2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jhn.2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0508:
ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, see word), -ου, τό 
 (ἀνά, γῆ), 
an upper room: Mrk.14:15, Luk.22:12.†
 SYN.: ὑπερῷον  (AS)
G0509:
ἄνωθεν
  adv (ἄνω), 
__(a) from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., Jhn.19:28; meaning, from heaven: Jhn.3:31 19:11, Jas.1:17 3:15, 17 . 
 __(b) from the first, from the beginning: Luk.1:3, Act.26:5; whence 
 __(with) anew, again: Jhn.3:3, 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., Gal.4:9 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0511:
ἀνώτερος, α, -ον 
 [in LXX: Neh.3:25 (עֶלְיוֹן), Eze.41:7 (מַעַל), Tob.8:3 * ;] 
only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος), 
 __(a) of motion, higher: Luk.14:10; 
 __(b) of rest, above, before: Heb.10:8.†
 (AS)
G0512:
ἀν-ωφελής, -ές
 (ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: Isa.44:10 (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) Jer.2:8 (יָעַל לֹא), Pro.28:3, Wis.1:11 * ;] 
unprofitable: Tit.3:9; neut. as subst., unprofitableness: Heb.7:18.†
 (AS)
G0513:
αξίνη, -ης, ἡ 
 [in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;] 
an axe: Mat.3:10, Luk.3:9.†
 (AS)
G0515:
ἀξιόω, -ῶ
 (ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in Wis.1:1-16, 2 Mac ;] 
__(a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), Luk.7:7; id. and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:11; pass. with genitive of thing(s), 1Ti.5:17, Heb.3:3 10:29 
 __(b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), Act.15:38 28:22.†
 (AS)
G0516:
ἀξίως, 
  adv. [in LXX: Wis.7:15 16:1, Sir.14:11 * ;] 
worthily: Rom.16:2, Eph.4:1, Php.1:27; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, Col.1:10; τ. θεοῦ 1Th.2:12, 3Jn.6.†
 (AS)
G0517:
ἀόρατος, -ον
 (ὁράω), [in LXX: Gen.1:2 (תֹּהוּ), Isa.45:3 (מִסְתָּר), 2Ma.9:5 * ;] 
unseen, invisible: Rom.1:20, Col.1:15-16, 1Ti.1:17, Heb.11:27.†
 (AS)
G0518:
ἀπ-αγγέλλω 
 [in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi. ;] 
of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Act.4:23, al.; with dative of person(s), Mat.2:8, al.; before ὃτι, Luk.18:37; πῶς, Luk.8:36; περί, Luk.7:18 13:1, Act.28:21, 1Th.1:9; λέγων, Act.22:26; with accusative and inf., Act.12:14; before εἰς, Mrk.5:14, Luk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25) 
 (AS)
G0519:
ἀπ-άγχω
 (ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: 2Ki.17:23 (חָנַק), Tob.3:10 * ;] 
to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): Mat.27:5.†
 (AS)
G0520:
ἀπ-άγω 
 [in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;] 
to lead away: Luk.13:15, Act.23:17 24:7 (R, mg.), 1Co.12:2; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.26:57 27:2, 31, Mrk.14:44, 53 15:16, Luk.21:12 22:66 23:26, Act.12:19; of the direction of a way: Mat.7:13-14 (cf. συν-απ-άγω).†
 (AS)
G0521:
ἀ-παίδευτος, -ον
 (παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;] 
uninstructed, ignorant: 2Ti.2:23.†
 (AS)
G0522:
ἀπ-αίρω 
 [in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;] 
to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: Mat.9:15, Mrk.2:20, Luk.5:35.†
 (AS)
G0523:
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX: Deu.15:2-3, al. (נָגַשׂ), Sir.20:15, Wis.15:8, al. ;] 
to ask back, demand back: Luk.6:30 12:20 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0524:
ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ 
 __1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61). 
 __2. In late Gk. 
 __(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5); 
 __(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Eph.4:19.†
 (AS)
G0525:
ἀπ-αλλάσσω 
 [in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;] 
to remove, release: Heb.2:15; pass., to depart: Act.19:12; in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: Luk.12:58 (Cremer, 90, 632).†
 (AS)
G0526:
ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;] 
to alienate, estrange; pass.: Eph.2:12 4:18, Col.1:21 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).† 
 (AS)
G0527:
ἀπαλός, -ή, -όν 
 [in LXX for רַךְ ;] 
tender: Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28.†
 (AS)
G0528:
ἀπαντάω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX chiefly for פָּגַע ;] 
__1. to go to meet. 
 __2. to meet; with dative: Mrk.14:13, Luk.17:12 (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).†
 (AS)
G0529:
ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: Mat.25:6 27:32 (WH, txt., omits), Act.28:15, 1Th.4:17 (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).†
 (AS)
G0530:
ἅπαξ 
 adv., [in LXX for אֶחָד, פַּעַם ;] 
__(a) once: 2Co.11:25, Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., Heb.12:26-27; ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, Heb.9:7; καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: Php.4:16, 1Th.2:18; 
 __(b) once for all: Heb.6:4 9:28 10:2, 1Pe.3:18, Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0531:
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον
 (παραβαίνω), 
inviolable, and so unchangeable: Heb.7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0533:
ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon., 
 [in LXX: Isa.31:7 (מָאַס) * ;] 
to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), Mat.16:24, Mrk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:23 (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, Mat.26:34-35, 75, Mrk.14:30-31, 72, Luk.22:34, 61; pass., Luk.12:9 (Cremer, 111).†
 (AS)
G0534:
ἀπάρτι
 (WH, ἀπ᾽ ἄρτι; cl., ἀπαρτί, ν. MM, VGT, see word); adv., [not in LXX, where עַתָּה is rendered by ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ;] 
from now, henceforth: Jhn.13:19 14:7, Rev.14:13.†
 (AS)
G0535:
ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
 (ἀπαρτίζω, to finish), 
completion: Luk.14:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0536:
ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
 (ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;] 
__1. the beginning of a sacrifice. 
 __2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Num.15:20), Rom.11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Rom.8:23; of Christians: Rom.16:5, 1, 1Co.16:15, 2Th.2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Jas.1:18, Rev.14:4; of Christ: 1Co.15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0537:
ἅπας, -ασα, -αν
 (strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-), 
all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as Luk.3:21; or after, as Mrk.16:15]; absol., in masc., as Luk.5:26; in neut., as Act.2:44; ἅ. οὗτοι, Act.2:7 (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, Gal.3:28 (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word) 
 (AS)
G0538:
ἀπατάω, -ῶ

to deceive: with accusative, Jas.1:26; with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), Eph.5:6; pass., 1Ti.2:14 (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).†
 (AS)
G0539:
ἀπάτη, -ης, ἡ 
 [in LXX: Ecc.9:6 א (no Heb. equiv.), Jdth.9:3, 10 9:13 16:8, 4Ma.18:8 * ;] 
deceit, deceitfulness: Col.2:8; τοῦ πλούτου, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:19 (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, 2Th.2:10; τῆς ἁμαρτίας, Heb.3:13; αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., Eph.4:22. pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): 2Pe.2:13 (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).†
 (AS)
G0540:
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
 (ἀ- neg., πατήρ)

 __2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Heb.7:3.†

ἀπ-εῖδον (WH, ἀφ-, ν. Bl., § 4, 3), 2 aor. without present in use (cf. εἶδον), serving as aor. to ἀφοράω, q.v

G0543:

G0544:
ἀπειθέω, -ῶ
 (ἀπειθής), [in LXX for מָרָה, סָרַר, etc. ;] 
as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., Act.14:2 19:9, Rom.10:21 11:31 15:31, Heb.3:18 11:31, 1Pe.3:20; with dative, Jhn.3:36, Rom.2:8 11:30, 1Pe.2:8 3:1 4:17 (Cremer, 475).†

G0545:
ἀπειθής, -ές

disobedient: absol., Luk.1:17, Tit.1:16 3:3; with dative, Act.26:19, Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.†

G0546:
ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή)

to threaten: 1Pe.2:23; mid., Act.4:17 (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).†

ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ 
 [in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;] 
threatening, threat: Act.4:29 9:1, Eph.6:9.†
 (AS)
G0548:
ἄπ-ειμι
 (εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;] 
to be absent: 1Co.5:3, 2Co.10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Php.1:27, Col.2:5.†

G0550:

 [in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to tell out. 
 __2. to forbid (3Ki.11:2). 
 __3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), 2Co.4:2.†
 (AS)
G0551:
απείραστος, -ον
 (πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω),

G0552:
ἄπειρος, -ον

without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), Heb.5:13 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0553:
ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι  depon.,

G0554:
ἀπ-εκ-δύω 
 to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: Col.3:9; to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), Col.2:15.†
 (AS)
G0555:
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ 
 (ἀπεκδύω) 
a putting or stripping off: Col.2:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)
G0556:
ἀπ-ελαύνω 
 [in LXX for נָצַל, שָׁלַח ;] 
to drive away: Act.18:16 (MM, see word).†
 (AS)
G0557:
ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ

G0558:

G0559:
Ἀπελλῆς, -οῦ, accusative -ῆν (MM, see word), ὁ 
 Apelles: Rom.16:10.†

ἀπ-ελπίζω

 __2. to hope to receive from or in return (Field, Notes, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., Lex., see word): with accusative (M; Pr., 65; MM, see word), Luk.6:35.†

G0561:
ἀπ-έναντι

 __1. over against (MM, see word): Mat.27:61, Mrk.12:41, WH, mg. 
 __2. before, in the presence of: Mat.27:24 (WH, mg.), Act.3:16, Rom.3:18.

G0562:
ἀπέραντος, -ον

ἀπεριστπάστως

without distraction: 1Co.7:35.†

G0564:
ἀ-περί-τμητος, -ον

 (AS)
G0565:
ἀπέρχομαι, 
 [in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;] 
 __1. to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the  thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word);

 __(b) with mention of place or person: εἰς, Mat.14:15; ἐπί, Luk.24:24; πρός, Rev.10:9; ἀπό, Luk.1:38; ἐξω, Act.4:15; ἐκεῖ, Mat.2:22. 
 __2. As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), to go after, follow: Mrk.1:20, Jhn.12:19; metaphorically, Mrk.1:42, Rev.21:1.

to receive (in full); to be distant; (middle) to abstain, avoid 
trans. to have in full what is due or is sought, Mt. 6:2, 5, 16; Lk. 6:24; Phil. 4:18; to have altogether, Phlm. 15; hence, it is enough, Mk. 14:41; intransitive to be distant, Lk. 7:6; to be estranged, Mt. 15:8; Mk. 7:6, middle to abstain from, Acts 14:20
G0567: refrain, receive/be far, keep away from
G0568:
ἀπ-έχω 
 [in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;] 
__1. trans., 
 __(a) to hold back, keep off; 
 __(b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, Mat.6:2, 5 6:16, Luk.6:24, Php.4:18, Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: Mrk.14:41. 
 __2. Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., Luk.15:20; before ἀπό, Mat.14:24 15:8, Mrk.7:6, Luk.7:6 15:20 24:13. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, Act.15:29, 1Ti.4:3, 1Pe.2:11; before ἀπό, Act.15:20, 1Th.4:3 5:22.†
 (AS)
G0569:
ἀπιστέω, -ῶ
 (ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13, Sir.1:27, 2Ma.8:13 * ;]

 __2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).†
 (AS)
G0570:
